pair_bootstrap.resampling_unit: service pairs (treats 990 dependent pairs as iid)

cluster_bootstrap.resampling_unit: services (cluster bootstrap). CONSTRUCTION, stated explicitly so a replicator reproduces the replicate pair-count distribution (median 406, p5 300, p95 496): each replicate draws 45 services WITH REPLACEMENT from the 45; the drawn services are then DEDUPLICATED TO A SET (a service drawn twice appears once, keeping identity but not multiplicity); the complete graph is rebuilt on that distinct set, EXCLUDING self-pairs; the statistic is recomputed on that replicate's distinct unordered pairs. Contrast: retaining multiplicity as weights (pair weighted m_i*m_j) would instead give ~968 pair-instances and a materially different interval — that construction is NOT used here. A 200,000-trial simulation of this exact construction reproduces the 406/300/496 distribution.

dependency_note: The 990 pairs are the complete graph on 45 services (degree 44 each). Pairs sharing a service are correlated, so the pair bootstrap is anti-conservative. The cluster bootstrap is the defensible interval.
